_readme: See memory-layer/README.md for what this hook does, what it costs, and how to remove it. This file shows the hook entry in both OS forms; the installer merges only the OS-correct one into the project's .claude/settings.json, under its top-level "hooks" key, alongside any hooks already there.

windows._readme: The installer writes the project's absolute path in place of <ABSOLUTE-PROJECT-PATH> at merge time. An absolute -File path is inert under both Git Bash and PowerShell as the hook shell, so this one command string works regardless of which shell the machine uses.
